key.decision_why: The author answered the maintainer's feedback with the same approach and the same files, so a short note under the existing card is the right size, and no maintainer is assigned who would otherwise handle it.
key.action_why: laurynmm replied that the screenshots still did not meet the guidelines and asked for concise communication instead of long AI-generated comments, which is a request for more work.
changed: The description now has a "Relationship to prior work" section comparing this PR with the completion candidate #33086.
The section explains the difference: one shared helper instead of reworked regexes, framed as answering timabbott's complexity concern.
The author says the whitespace-after-`](` case is now handled and tested, but the code change since the feedback can't be verified.
The description flags the regex-alignment question from #33086 as out of scope and explains why `marked.cjs` was left alone.
still_missing: The before/after screenshots are still separate lists of images rather than precise, paired before/after comparisons as the guidelines require.
The explanatory frontend comment that maintainers asked for on #33086 is still left out.
The image-syntax limitation the author says they flagged doesn't appear in the visible description.
key.reply_ask: Thank the author for discussing #33086, and ask them to re-present the screenshots as precise, paired before/after comparisons following the presenting-visual-changes guidelines before review can continue.

must_have.fact: Says the before/after screenshots are still not presented as paired, comparable before/after images per the guidelines, so laurynmm's second ask is not done.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and giving more feedback rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Says the description now discusses the completion candidate PR #33086, so the first ask is addressed.
Notes that code changes since the feedback couldn't be determined, so the claimed whitespace fix and test are unverified.
Mentions that the PR leaves out the frontend `marked.cjs` comment that maintainers asked for on #33086.
